title: Birthday Wishes in Marathi – Heartfelt Marathi Birthday Messages
author: Birthday
description:
Welcome to Birthday Wishes in Marathi, a podcast dedicated to beautiful, heartfelt, and meaningful birthday wishes in the Marathi language.

Birthdays are special moments that give us an opportunity to celebrate the people we love and appreciate. A simple birthday message can bring a smile to someone's face, make them feel remembered, and create a beautiful memory. But sometimes, finding the right words can be difficult. This podcast is created to help you discover the perfect birthday wishes for every special person and every special relationship in your life.

At https://birthdaywishinmarathi.org/, we explore a wide variety of Marathi birthday wishes, messages, greetings, quotes, and ideas that you can easily share with your loved ones. Whether you are looking for a sweet message for your mother or father, a loving wish for your husband or wife, a special message for your brother or sister, or a fun birthday greeting for your best friend, you will find inspiration here.

Our episodes cover different types of birthday messages, including emotional birthday wishes, romantic birthday wishes, funny birthday messages, short WhatsApp birthday wishes, traditional Marathi greetings, heartfelt wishes, and inspirational birthday quotes. We also explore birthday wishes for children, parents, grandparents, teachers, relatives, colleagues, and other important people in your life.

Marathi is a beautiful language that allows emotions and feelings to be expressed in a warm and personal way. Sending a birthday wish in Marathi can make your greeting feel more connected and meaningful, especially when the recipient understands and loves the language.

Each episode is designed to give you simple and useful ideas that you can use for birthday cards, WhatsApp messages, social media posts, text messages, or personal greetings. Whether you want something short and simple or a longer emotional message, our podcast aims to help you find words that truly express your feelings.

Along with our podcast, you can explore BirthdayWishInMarathi.org for more Marathi birthday wishes and messages organized around different relationships, occasions, and styles. Our goal is to make it easier for you to find the right words whenever someone special in your life has a birthday.

So, if you love sharing meaningful birthday wishes in Marathi, make Birthday Wishes in Marathi part of your celebration. Listen to our episodes, discover new messages, and share your favorite wishes with the people who matter most to you.

Thank you for listening and joining us. We hope our Marathi birthday wishes help you make every birthday a little more joyful, personal, and memorable.

For more beautiful Marathi birthday wishes, visit BirthdayWishInMarathi.org.

Celebrate birthdays. Share happiness. Express your feelings with words from the heart.

Happy Birthday and best wishes for a wonderful year ahead!

Thomas identified the field's dynamics and wrote the initial thesis; Flavia named the field and edited the content. Together, they authored the manifesto and published it on Brandingmag.
Thomas spent thirty years in global brand leadership—across creative, design, digital, and strategy—governing brands and shaping how they express themselves across businesses and markets. Flavia has led Brandingmag as editor-in-chief for well over a decade and builds editorial strategies for large organizations with her team at Brandura, the publisher's consulting arm. Every episode is the two of them (sometimes joined by a guest) testing the 2025 manifesto against what's happened since and evolving the pillars and practices of agentic branding in the process.

The series looks at the pressure AI creates on firms and markets, what it takes to make adoption stick, and how businesses can move beyond using AI as a tool to redesign workflows, operating models and the role of human judgement.

Adopt AI to keep up.
Transform with AI to get ahead.
Build execution intelligence to stay ahead.

title: Enjoy The Journey
author: Tom Kenemore & Cheri Meeks
description:
A podcast about Spiritual awakening, consciousness, and what it actually means to wake up inside your own life.


What if the peace you've been searching for doesn't arrive in a 9-to-5 LIFE — but on a long drive, or in a quiet campsite with no one around for miles?


I'm Tom and with my partner Cheri, we've spent nearly a decade living and traveling in an RV. The deeper journey didn't start on the road — but the road is where we finally slowed down enough to hear it.


Every week we sit down with people whose lives were changed by something they couldn't explain — near-death experiences, spiritual awakenings, and the quiet shifts that happen when an ordinary life quietly stops being enough.


Together we explore:

• Consciousness 

• Inner peace 

• Life purpose 

• Intuition 

• The afterlife 

• The questions most of us only ask in the dark


No hype. No jargon. No asking you to believe anything you can't feel for yourself.


THE ROAD IS A SPIRITUAL PATH


Because so much of our own awakening happened on wheels, one thread runs through every conversation. Nature, solitude, letting go of the house and the stuff and the schedule. It turns out the RV was never really the point — getting out there was simply how we got quiet enough to hear what was already there.


Awakening isn't about leaving your life behind. It's about finally being awake inside the one you already have.


If you've felt the pull toward something more — after a loss, a close call, or in the silence of a long drive — you're in the right place.


New episodes weekly. Follow Enjoy the Journey on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you listen.

description:
Physical AI and humanoid robots, decoded for European business leaders by two founders who spent 15 years on the other side.


The Robot Bureau is a monthly podcast on physical AI, humanoid robots and the Chinese companies building them, made for business leaders in Europe who need to understand what is coming before it arrives.


It is hosted by two people who have spent their careers as mirror images of each other. Rogier is a European founder who built and sold companies in China over 15 years. Lei is a Chinese founder who has spent 15 years building businesses in Europe. Between them they read the Chinese sources, sit in the Shenzhen showrooms and the European boardrooms, and translate what each side gets wrong about the other.


Every episode follows the same format. We pick the biggest headlines of the month, from Unitree and AgiBot to Bosch and Schaeffler, from a $6 billion funding round to a robot factory opening in Serbia, and then go beyond the headline to find the real story. We pitch those stories to each other, argue about what they mean, and end every episode with a verdict: which story makes the front page, which one is a nothing burger, and which one gets spiked.


We have all seen the demo videos, the kung fu moves and the robot Olympics. This show is about what is actually happening behind them: who is shipping, who is buying, who is on the bill of materials, and what it means if you run a business in Europe.


Reporting from Europe and China. New episodes every month.

title: Angielski na luzie. Projekt Ósmoklasista
author: Kinga Zabłocka
description:
Na hasło "egzamin ósmoklasisty" czujesz dreszcze, a wizja majowych arkuszy spędza Ci sen z powiek? Spokojnie, ogarniemy to!

"Angielski na luzie" to Twój bezstresowy przewodnik po egzaminie z języka angielskiego. Zamiast wkuwać wszystko na miesiąc przed, ruszamy z przygotowaniami we wrześniu. Małymi krokami, bez paniki i bez zarywania nocy budujemy formę, która w maju pozwoli Ci napisać arkusz na maksa.
W krótkich, 10-15 minutowych odcinkach rozkładamy egzamin CKE na czynniki pierwsze. Tłumaczę znienawidzone czasy gramatyczne bez nudnych regułek, demaskuję największe pułapki (tzw. dystraktory) i sprzedaję sprawdzone triki na darmowe punkty z e-maila.
Czego możesz się spodziewać?
Zero owijania w bawełnę: Skupiamy się tylko na tym, co realnie pojawia się na testach.
Strategii i lifehacków: Jak strzelać w lukach, gdy nie znasz słowa, i jak słuchać, żeby usłyszeć odpowiedź.
Materiałów bonusowych: Do odcinków dorzucam estetyczne, konkretne ściągawki w PDF, checklisty i mapy myśli do pobrania, które od razu możesz powiesić nad biurkiem.
Podcast to maraton, a nie sprint – startujemy od podstaw i powoli wchodzimy na wyższe obroty, żeby na wiosnę szlifować same detale. Zaparz ulubioną herbatę, załóż słuchawki i przekonaj się, że angielski da się lubić.

Zaobserwuj, żeby nie przegapić żadnego odcinka. A jeśli szukasz więcej szybkich tipów, quizów i edukacyjnych kulis, wpadnij na Facebook'a:

https://www.facebook.com/profi...

Tam oprócz dodatkowych zadań do samodzielnego ćwiczenia będę wrzucać więcej porad!

title: The unofficial Alton Towers podcast
author: Unofficial Alton Towers
description:
The Unofficial Alton Towers Podcast

Alton Towers has been drawing visitors to the Staffordshire moorlands for over two hundred years — first as a private estate and gardens, then as one of Europe's most significant theme parks. It has given the world the first suspended looping coaster in Europe, one of the most famous inverted coasters ever built, and a catalogue of closed attractions that fans still argue about decades later.

It has also given the world four-hour queues, baffling car park charges and a fast-track system that costs more than the ticket.

This podcast covers both sides honestly.

What each episode covers

We alternate between deep dives and practical guides. Deep dives look at individual rides, the lore behind the theming, the engineering decisions, and the attractions that no longer exist. Practical episodes tackle the questions visitors actually ask — how to structure a day, when the park is genuinely quieter, whether an on-site hotel stay pays for itself, and how to avoid the traps that cost families hundreds of pounds a year.

Who it's for

Coaster enthusiasts who want the detail. Parents planning a first visit who don't want to waste money. Anyone who's been going since childhood and wants to know what happened to the rides they remember.

Why independent matters

Official channels have a job to do, and that job is selling tickets. Ours isn't. When a ride is running one train, we say so. When a package is poor value, we say so. When the park gets something right — and it frequently does — we say that too, and we mean it.

The Unofficial Alton Towers Podcast is produced by the team behind unofficialaltontowers.co.uk, an independent visitor guide and fan site.

The Unofficial Alton Towers Podcast and unofficialaltontowers.co.uk are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Alton Towers Resort or Merlin Entertainments. All views are our own.

We grew up in a continent that promised peace, openness and prosperity. Yet today, Europe seems increasingly shaped by new divisions : inequality is growing, trust is fading, social pressures are intensifying, and uncertainty has become part of everyday life.


What does it mean to live a dignified life in Europe today ? Is equity still an achievable goal ? How much do the country we are born in, the family we inherit, the opportunities we receive and the choices we make shape our lives ?


Each episode begins with a question to explore our times through conversations that connect philosophy, society, economics, geopolitics and everyday life. INEQUITY seeks to understand not only how we live today, but how we could live better.

We do not offer easy answers. We choose nuance over certainty, complexity over slogans, and dialogue over polarization.

Because in a world that keeps accelerating, thinking together may already be a form of resistance.

title: Guys who are fools
author: Susan Cohen
description:
What happens when a niche Facebook group transforms into a digital kangaroo court?

In this episode, we dive deep into a chilling, textbook case of extreme online vigilantism, social media extortion, and crowdsourced public humiliation. When a private dispute spilled onto the internet, a Facebook group admin named Mary Cetovitch didn’t just rally a local mob across Chicago and Milwaukee to deface a man's online identity—she held his digital life hostage.

We look step-by-step at the jaw-dropping receipts of how the group chat weaponized explicit, compromised personal data to force Steven Franks into total compliance. This wasn’t just a demand for a standard apology; it was a highly orchestrated, deeply degrading hostage negotiation. Franks was given a brutal ultimatum: watch his personal life and marriage be permanently destroyed online, or record a highly scripted video apology inside a pop-up hate group while wearing nothing but his underwear, "dolled up" for the amusement of a crowd.

As the internet mob gathered to watch the digital execution of a man's reputation, onlookers commented that the unfolding trainwreck was "literal gold," eating popcorn while a person was stripped bare on a modern public pillory.

We dissect the full timeline of the "Mama Drama" extortion ring, listen to the actual forced apology audio, explore the terrifying legal boundaries of digital coercion, and ask the ultimate question: Has modern public humiliation simply become a spectator sport?

Recommended Trigger Warning (Optional but advised for platform compliance):
Mature Audiences Only. This episode contains detailed discussions of cyber-bullying, explicit online defacement, sexual coercion, and digital extortion.

description:

Believe me, you are not. 


Each episode blends practical, science-backed tools with honest, faith-centered conversation. Real talk about gray area drinking, and how to stop drinking for stress relief, anxiety or burnout, and what it looks like to build an alcohol-free life you love. You'll also hear real stories from women who quit drinking and walked into the purpose God had been calling them to all along, because I believe, all the way down to my core: you were made for more.


This podcast is for you if:


That nightly glass of wine to take the edge off has become 2-3 glasses or more?


You look forward to your nightly wine a little too much? 


You've tried to cut back, and you can for a while, but then you overdo it again?


You don't think you're an "alcoholic", but you know something feels off.


Alcohol isn't ruining your life, but it's quietly taking something from it.


If you're nodding along, you are in the right place. And you don't have to figure this out alone!  Let's get started!

title: Tales of Love and Loss
author: Eleanor Quayle
description:
Tales of Love & Loss is a podcast about the loves that have shaped us and what happens when those loves are lost.
We all experience loss. Sometimes a relationship ends. Sometimes someone we love dies. Sometimes circumstances, timing or life itself separate us from the person we hoped to build a future with. And sometimes we lose a love that never quite had the chance to become what we imagined.
But what happens afterwards?
How do we make sense of what happened? What do we carry with us? And how does losing someone change the way we understand ourselves, love, relationships and the future?
Tales of Love & Loss gives people the opportunity to tell those stories.
Hosted by therapist Eleanor Quayle, each episode is an intimate, audio-only conversation with someone who has experienced the loss of a significant love. There is no performance, no pressure to have everything figured out and no expectation that a story will fit neatly into a beginning, middle and end. 
Some of these stories have hopeful or even happy endings. Some don't. 
Instead, these are honest conversations about love, loss, longing, resilience and how we find our way forward.
The podcast offers a safe, compassionate and non-judgemental space where guests can talk about experiences that may be difficult to put into words. Through telling their stories, we engage in the culturally vital process of sharing and hearing our experiences, and thus finding healing.
Tales of Love & Loss is interested in what lies beneath the obvious story of losing someone: the meaning we gave the relationship, the hopes we held, the things left unsaid, the ways loss can change us and the possibility of discovering strength, compassion and hope along the way.
At its heart, this podcast is about being heard. Come and listen to the stories. Perhaps you may hear something that stays with you and guides you in those darker moments of life.

title: This Will Make You Uncomfortable
author: Brian Mirsky
description:
Brian Mirsky, a Fourth Canadian Jew, talks about the harsh reality that Canadians are not as accepting of Jews as they think we are, and that Jews are still treated very differently than other minorities.

This is not another ‘angry minority with an agenda, but with no new talking points’ podcast.  That is not Brian, and not what this podcast is about.  Brian strives to make all fair minded Canadians aware that our country is losing its core values of tolerance and fair play. These values made us stand out from other countries and made us the envy of the world. 

Canada is fast becoming a country that accepts intimidation and intolerance. Violence against a community that has deep historic roots in this country and has contributed greatly to our country's success. Taken from a book about South Africa, the underlying theme for this podcast is that we should “Cry for our Beloved Country.”

Listen in to get the context you were never given, a clearer picture of what's actually happening in Canada, and a reason to care - whether or not you've thought much about Israel, Judaism, or the Middle East before.

Find Brian online at www.thiswillmakeyouuncomfortable.com

description:
You know that feeling when you see a woman in an incredible dress and just have to tell her? Or your best friend calls because she just has to tell you her news? That instinct to connect on a real, deeper level, with others and ourselves, it's disappearing, and it's costing us more than we realize.


"I Just Have to Tell You" is a raw, unfiltered podcast about connection, vulnerability, and authenticity for those who are done performing and ready to feel truly seen. Hosted by Jess Kiely-Vogelpohl and Monica Rozenfeld, this is a safe space for heart-to-heart, candid conversations about the real stuff: nervous system regulation and somatic healing, entrepreneurship, the identity shift of motherhood, postpartum and mental health, perimenopause and midlife burnout, breaking generational patterns and healing the mother/father wound, inner child work, attachment styles and relationship patterns, people-pleasing and perfectionism, late-in-life ADHD/neurodivergence in women, career burnout and reinvention, astrology and manifestation, friendship and loneliness, and learning to rest in a culture obsessed with hustle.


Sometimes it's just the two of us. Sometimes we bring in a guest with their own story they just have to tell. Every episode is honest, unpolished, and real, because healing was never meant to be a solo journey.


Follow along, and let's connect.

---- 


Mike Martin MP has authored several major books on conflict, most recently ‘How to Fight A War’ (Hurst, 2023). As an MP and a member of the UK Defence Select Committee, Mike sits at the interface of international geopolitical challenges, government, and the day-to-day concerns of voters.

Hassan is a senior advisor to many of the largest global philanthropies, UN agencies and governments, helping them to build concrete initiatives to tackle global challenges. His book, The Responsible Globalist (Allan Lane, 2019) set out a bold theory for how to strengthen international cooperation, which he now works to implement through his think tank, Global Nation.

From skin health and women’s health to wellness, ageing, nervous system regulation, business, mindset and everything in between these are conversations designed to make you think differently, feel differently and perhaps do something differently.

Stephanie’s mission is simple: to connect you with the right people, perspectives and information to help you create your next space.

Because Your Next Space isn’t just about where you are now.

It’s about creating space for the woman you’re becoming.

This is more than a podcast. It’s a platform for connection, conversation and real change.

Welcome to Your Next Space Conversations.

Let’s create some magic.

title: Let's talk Physie....
author: Emma + Jane (your new physie besties)
description: Join Emma and Jane — two gals who met through BJP Physie, grew up with it and now have children doing it too — for a light, positive and family-friendly celebration of all things BJP Physie. Discover its rich history, meet the people behind the scenes and explore the positions, traditions, competitions and quirky things that make Physie special. With Did You Know?, Position of the Week, Physie Picks, special guests and plenty of laughs, it’s the perfect listen on the way to Physie with Mum, Grandma and the kids.

title: The Hamlin Garland Library
author: Hamlin Garland
description:
Out beyond the towns, where the road runs deep through grass and dust, lie the lives Hamlin Garland knew best: farmers bent beneath hard labor, families pushing westward, restless sons and daughters dreaming of another life.

The Hamlin Garland Library brings these stories back to the open air. Tales of the Middle Border, of poverty and perseverance, of ambition, injustice, memory, and the stubborn beauty of the American prairie.

Follow the old roads, and meet the people who traveled them.

title: Whimsical Seasons
author: Whimsical Seasons
description: Whimsical Seasons is a creative destination for home décor, seasonal decorations, gifts, and squishy toys. The brand combines festive products with playful finds, offering options for holidays, special occasions, gifting, and everyday enjoyment. From decorative accents that brighten a room to satisfying squishy toys that provide hours of fun, Whimsical Seasons brings together products that celebrate creativity, comfort, and personality.

title: The Mansfield Nowcast
author: Mansfield Radio
description:
This is Mansfield Town Centre's very own dedicated podcast powered by Mansfield Forward Bid.


The Mansfield Nowcast is a monthly show designed to be a positive voice for the town centre put together with the help of Mansfield Radio.


Mansfield Radio's Paul Chadbourne will be in conversation with local business owners and other key players in the town centre's day to day life.


For more details about the work Mansfield Forward Bid does, head to their website https://mansfieldforward.bid/

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Beowa: Guardian of the Galactic Realm (Season 1) [English]
author: Kusanagi Riku, Closing Credits, GMBJapan
description:
IN COLLABORATION WITH CLOSING CREDITS PRESENTS BEOWA: GUARDIAN OF THE GALACTIC REALMS DRAMA CD!

Beowa, a skilled warrior living in the neon-lit world of Drowth, learns that the Citadel is facing a growing threat connected to the mysterious Quantum Abyss. Driven by a desire to understand both the danger and the unanswered questions surrounding her own past, she sets out with her trusted companion, Thalor.

Their journey takes them into the unpredictable Quantum Abyss, where reality itself becomes unstable, and Beowa begins to encounter strange visions and echoes tied to her history. With Thalor by her side and guidance from the Cosmic Wardens, she must navigate the dangerous environment while confronting questions about who she really is.

With Thalor by her side and guidance from the Cosmic Wardens, she must navigate the dangerous environment while confronting questions about who she really is.

title: Rewrite the Score
author: Ren Barlow
description:
Join visionary musicians, leaders, and creatives as they explore how to listen to yourself amid the noise. This is your guide to becoming the person you were always meant to be — free from limitations and fear. Hosted by creative changemaker Ren Barlow, music is the throughline of these stories, but finding your voice is the heart. Because whether we're writing a song or a life, we all have the power to rewrite the score.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Find Your Next Movie Night
author: Sharma
description: Sometimes choosing what to watch takes longer than watching it. This show explores https://tvdulo.com/ as a simpler way to browse movies and television shows, preview interesting titles, check what is trending, and build a collection of favorites for later.

title: Will AI Recommend You?
author: Simon Young - Question.Marketing Founder
description:
Will AI recommend your business, or your competitor's? Will AI Recommend You? is the podcast about AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation): how UK businesses get named by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity when a buyer asks who to use.


Hosted by Simon Young, founder of Question.Marketing. Thirty years in search, and publishing on AEO since October 2019, 1,153 days before ChatGPT launched.


Each episode answers one question business owners are actually asking. What gets a company cited? What's just SEO with a new sticker on it? What do the numbers say, and where are they still small? Plain English, a receipt for every claim, and guests who have done the work.


Ask an AI about your industry today. Does your name come up?


Full transcripts and show notes at question.marketing.

title: What am I doing in this world? -a writer's secret panic room
author: jieunthewriter
description: Chaotic world. A girlie living in Korea goes numb, overwhelmed by society and life. From money, jobs, and addiction to friends, romance, and aging like our parents, she dives into a few unexpected yet surprisingly universal concerns. Issues that somehow feel both terrifyingly important and ridiculously heavy. She’s starting to take off on her dream career as a writer, sharing not only these sporadic essays but also her personal journey of publishing her first novel. Messy, awkward, and self-roasting, but honest and liberating to lighten the weight of worries of any curious listeners.

title: Ver Historias Instagram Viewer
author: wifaxo3
description: Ver Historias lets you view Instagram stories from public profiles quickly and anonymously. No login or account is required. Enjoy a simple, private, and free way to explore Instagram stories from any device. If you want to get this kind of thing, here is the link to click on it: https://verhistorias.com/

title: Sourav's Podcast
author: Sourav
description: podcast about how build solid products

title: Club Fete Podcast
author: Fete
description: DJs & event organisers from Australia give a deep inside into what it’s like to live in the events industry.

title: HAL: Who Signed Off on This?
author: Christopher Sowa
description:
Every AI decision inside a company eventually lands on someone's desk with a pen.
HAL: Who Signed Off on This? is a series of short conversations with the people who sign: how they decide what to approve, where they insist a human still looks, and what they'd need to see before they'd trust a machine with more.
(HAL is the computer in 2001: A Space Odyssey, the AI that went rogue. The show is about the people who make sure that never happens on their watch.)

title: The Face Exchange's Podcast
author: The Face Exchange
description: Welcome to The Face Exchange! We're passionate about capturing unforgettable moments and have been bringing people together through interactive photography experiences since 2002. Based in Houston, we specialize in providing fun, stylish, and seamless photo entertainment for weddings, corporate or any other special event you are planning.

title: Entertainment on Every Screen
author: Rohit
description: Start watching on a mobile device and move your entertainment toward the biggest screen in the house. This show explores https://superhydra.net/ through the changing way people consume movies, series, television, and other digital programming across different devices.

title: The Business Blueprint
author: Rashed Mia
description:
Welcome to The Business Blueprint — your go-to podcast for practical business ideas, entrepreneurship, startups, side hustles, and strategies for building a better financial future.

Whether you’re dreaming of starting your first business, looking for a profitable side hustle, exploring new business opportunities, or simply want to understand how successful entrepreneurs think, this podcast is designed to give you ideas you can actually use.

Each episode explores business ideas, startup strategies, marketing, money-making opportunities, personal growth, entrepreneurship lessons, and inspiring success stories from the world of business.

We break down complex business concepts into simple, easy-to-understand conversations so you can learn, think bigger, and take action.

The Business Blueprint is for aspiring entrepreneurs, small business owners, creators, professionals, and anyone who wants to turn ideas into opportunities.

🎙️ Ideas. Strategies. Success.


Subscribe and start building your own blueprint for success.

title: Throughput (TC Energy)
author: Compound Governance, Inc.
description: The TC Energy file: what was promised against what moved through the pipe. TC Energy owns 93,000 kilometres of natural gas pipeline across Canada, the United States and Mexico, moves about a quarter of the continent's gas, and holds 48 percent of Bruce Power, the largest operating nuclear site in the world. Since it spun off its oil pipelines in 2024 it has been a pure gas-and-power company with a declared model: six to seven billion dollars a year of capital, five to seven percent growth, an upper limit on leverage, and a demand forecast that keeps going up. Each episode is the audio edition of a written director-grade briefing: the declared model scored against the quarter, the assumptions behind the long-term case taken apart one by one, and three questions worth bringing to the table. Built entirely from the public record: filings, decks, calls, the circular and the tape. One quarter at a time.

title: The Insightful Leader
author: Kellogg School of Management
description: Expert advice and cutting-edge discoveries from one of the world's leading business schools.

title: Just Ask A Dad
author: Peter Street
description:
What’s a question you wish you could ask your dad?

Maybe you grew up without a father, lost your dad, or had a dad who was physically present but emotionally absent. Maybe you had a great dad, but there are still questions you never got the chance to ask.


Just Ask a Dad with Peter Street is a podcast for the practical, personal, awkward, and honest questions you sometimes just need a dad to answer.

From dating, relationships, breakups, and emotional struggles to practical life skills, changing a tire, navigating adulthood, and the questions no one taught you how to ask—nothing is off the table.


Peter is a father of four who believes you’re never too young—or too old—to need a healthy dad’s perspective. In a generation where so many have grown up without a healthy father figure, Just Ask a Dad creates a place to ask the questions you never got to ask.


Life gets messy. It's OK to ask the questions.

title: The Ignited  Generation Podcast
author: Olugbemisola & David Olabode
description:
The Ignited Generation Podcast is one for Youth & Young Adults. It is set to curate conversations that awaken passion for God, purpose and Kingdom impact.

 

This podcast is a space for honest conversations, biblical teaching, practical wisdom, encouragement, and inspiration designed to help you grow in your relationship with God and become all He has called you to be.

title: Surah Baqarah Audio Guide
author: Yusuf Adam
description: Explore clear and accessible audio guides about Surah Al-Baqarah, including its meanings, themes, virtues, important verses, and practical Islamic lessons. This podcast is created for listeners who want to learn about the Quran through simple, informative audio content.

title: Cornerstone Bible Church (McPherson)
author: Cornerstone Bible Church
description: Cornerstone exists to display God's glory by making disciples through His Word. Weekly expository preaching from Cornerstone Bible Church in McPherson, Kansas, including Bible conferences and midweek studies, archived back to 2016.

title: LIFEJACKET
author: LIFEJACKET
description:
LIFEJACKET is your destination for fans of football, fashion and music. Produced by John Fendley LIFEJACKET will provide considered content featuring notable names from their respective fields.
Our channel will also help to grow a community which celebrates the things we all love. Life is tough. Mental wellbeing is at the forefront of everything we plan to do here at LIFEJACKET. We all talk about football, fashion and music as a means of comfort, it brings us joy and can be a distraction from the pressures of everyday life. 
And we want you to be distracted.

title: Rated R Bible Study
author: Westminster Presbyterian Church
description:
The Bible is messier, stranger, and far more interesting than many of us were taught. Rated R Bible Study goes beyond the sanitized Sunday School versions of Scripture to explore the unfiltered, unvarnished, and sometimes unbelievable truths of the Christian faith.


Hosted by Landon Whitsitt, Senior Pastor of Westminster Presbyterian Church in Oklahoma City, each episode takes a fresh look at Scripture, theology, and the things Christians think they know, without cleaning up the difficult parts or avoiding the questions we were taught not to ask.


This is Bible study without the filter. Come ready to rethink a few things.

title: Price Check (Loblaw)
author: Compound Governance, Inc
description: The Loblaw file: what the shelf tag says against what the ledger says. Loblaw Companies is Canada's largest retailer, the grocer behind Loblaws, Real Canadian Superstore, No Frills and Maxi, the pharmacist behind Shoppers Drug Mart, the loyalty program behind PC Optimum, and, since its September 2026 Investor Day, a company whose declared growth model leans on the pharmacy counter and on businesses that are not retail at all. Each episode is the audio edition of a written director-grade briefing: the company's declared model scored against the quarter, the questions the Street asked and the ones it did not, and three questions worth bringing to the table. Built entirely from the public record: filings, decks, calls, named press, and the tape. One quarter at a time.

title: NeuroSocioal
author: bombardilo krokodilo
description:
Berikut beberapa pilihan deskripsi akun podcast NeuroSocial yang bisa kamu pakai, tergantung tone yang kamu mau:
Opsi 1: Minimalis & Modern (Cocok untuk Spotify/Apple Podcasts)
Welcome to NeuroSocial.
A podcast exploring the intersection of philosophy, culture, and human society. We dive deep into the ideas shaping our minds, the cultural norms we live by, and the social dynamics that connect us all.
Join us as we question the status quo and make sense of the modern world, one conversation at a time.

title: Real Talk with Dede
author: Destiny
description: Real Talk with Dede is a podcast where we have honest conversations about life, relationships, growth, and the everyday experiences we all go through. No filters, no pretending, just real talk.

title: Smoking Mad with Lovesd4rkness
author: outlawdawgg
description: Outlaw by choice, rebel by nature.  Love him or hate him, there's a reason you keep coming back for more . ) Life stories, worldly perspectives and advice from Generation X.  Traveler, adventurer, former AM radio DJ, father to many children.  Michael Robert Lombardi was born in 1974 in Yonkers, NY and grew up through the birth of rap and was in movies from the age of 3 . Lovesd4rkness premiered his Live show in March 2017 on Twitch (2017-2026). Starmaker (2020/21/26), Tiktok (2021-2026). Maniaac Productions 1991/2026

title: The Regional Experts Show
author: Tori Kopke
description: Welcome to The Regional Experts Show with Tori Kopke, where I take you from big idea to even bigger income! Whether you're a budding entrepreneur, a seasoned business owner, or someone with a passion project waiting to be unleashed, this is the place where big dreams meet even bigger strategies. This is THE podcast for rural and regional entrepreneurs, ready to go big in the bush.

title: Did You Know
author: Eric Thompson
description: Did You Know? is the podcast that uncovers remarkable, lesser-known stories that challenge what we think we know about history. Each episode takes you on a journey into the surprising, the overlooked, and the almost-forgotten — from bizarre disasters and extraordinary survival tales to hidden moments that shaped the world in unexpected ways.Hosted with curiosity and storytelling flair, Did You Know? reveals the rest of the story behind events you thought you understood — and many you’ve probably never heard before. With immersive detail, dramatic pacing, and thought-provoking reflection, every episode pulls back the curtain on the mysteries and marvels of our past.If you love history that surprises, amazes, and sometimes shocks, Did You Know? is your next favorite podcast. Subscribe and discover the stories that change how you see the world.

title: Chismis Corner
author: WPTS Radio
description: In Chismis Corner, a WPTS Radio podcast, hosts Kai Cruz, Noah Mendoza, and Urban Ramirez discuss their experiences as Filipino students at Pitt, and as Filipino people living in the Pittsburgh area. "Chismis", meaning gossip, gives the listener an idea of what to expect from this pod produced in collaboration with the Filipino Students Association at the Univeristy of Pittsburgh. Follow the Filipino Students Association on Instagram @fsapittsburgh, and keep listening to learn more about Filipino culture at home and abroad!

title: Aries Lounge
author: JS-1 Tha Supplier
description: This is a platform created for conversations about culture, cognac & real life!! Created & hosted by @js1thasupplier & @Whois_djpill. Enjoy great moments for 35 and over Black Americans.

title: Leadership, Business and Entrepreneurship in an Ai world
author: Cj
description: Leadership, Business and Entrepreneurship in an AI World explores how technology is reshaping the way we lead, build, work, and create. The podcast brings you honest conversations with entrepreneurs, executives, innovators, and thought leaders navigating a rapidly changing world. From AI and business strategy to leadership, innovation, personal growth, and the future of work, we go beyond the hype to uncover practical ideas, real experiences, and perspectives that can help you think differently and lead better.

title: Salt + Fruit
author: Salt + Fruit
description:
Salt + Fruit is a podcast for women tired of performing.

Through honest conversations about faith, identity, relationships, motherhood, control, and calling, we’re making room for the questions we don’t always know how to say out loud—and discovering what’s waiting on the other side of surrender.

Come sit with us.

title: The Divine Order
author: Goblin Tuesday
description:
What Happens When the Angels no longer wish to serve the gods they were created to worship?
The Divine Order follows a band of survivors who were never meant to fit into this new design:
Atlas: A ranger whose internal swarm is a dying echo of a forgotten realm.
Punch: An artificer/cleric clinging to the soot and gears of a world that has been smoothed over and missing the voice of her goddess.
Sister Seren: A monk whose "mercy" has no place in a world that refuses to feel.
Nymjra: A paladin carrying the secret whispers of a god who claims to be the shadow in the light.

title: Once Upon Growing Up
author: Once Upon Growing Up
description:
Welcome to Once Upon Growing Up, a cozy bedtime story podcast where little adventures lead to big lessons. Follow B and James through sweet, relatable stories about growing up, friendship, feelings, kindness, and everyday childhood moments. Each episode winds down with a gentle question to talk about together and a simple prayer — creating a peaceful way for families to end the day.
Snuggle in, get cozy, and let’s begin. ✨

title: Wassup Worshipper
author: Craig Jackson
description: Wassup Worshipper is a weekly audio podcast created to encourage, challenge, and strengthen the heart of the worshipper. Each week, join Craig Jackson for scripture, real conversations about worship and life, a weekly challenge, and prayer. Because before the platform, the title, or the microphone -- we’re just worshippers.

title: The Science of E-Commerce Advertising.
author: Hirdesh Matai
description: Scientific Advertising applied to ecommerce. How to turn customer and product truth into ads you can test, hooks, copy, creative, campaigns, and learn from what the market actually does. Hosted by Hirdesh Matai, founder of HDM GRO-ads.

title: Drift Willow
author: Mark
description: A candid look at starting over, cutting away excess, and finding solid ground in midlife. Drift Willow features spoken reflections and personal essays on career reinvention, personal autonomy, and the practical realities of stepping off the conventional path. Honest observations on work, downsizing, and building a simpler, more deliberate life.

title: The Idea Pile
author: Abigail Straebler and Sam Smith
description: College students Sam Smith and Abigail Straebler think too many thoughts, and now it’s your job to sort through them. They talk about whatever’s on their minds and often there will be a third friend joining the pile. Think of yourself less as an audience member and more like you’re someone overhearing our odd conversation on a train… or something. We are Performing Arts majors, so expect a good amount of theater and music talk as well!

title: Oasis Church Portsmouth Sunday Messages
author: Oasis Church Portsmouth
description: Sunday morning sermons from Oasis Church Portsmouth.

title: #ProudToBeBlueCollar® Show
author: Chris Crew and Jeremy Self
description: #ProudToBeBlueCollar® Show is a podcast about the people who build careers in the blue collar trades and are Proud To Be Blue Collar. Hosted by Chris Crew and Jeremy Self of The Blue Collar Success Group®, each episode features a guest from the home service industry sharing how they got into the trades, what it took to succeed, and the tips and skills they use in their role every day. Who this podcast is for This show is for anyone working in or curious about the home service trades, including HVAC, plumbing, and electrical. That means business owners and managers, but it also means salespeople, service technicians, installers, CSRs, and dispatchers. If you are considering a career in the trades and want to hear what the path actually looks like from people who walked it, start here. What you will hear in each episode Every episode centers on one guest and one story. We cover how they found the industry, most of them did not plan on it, what the early years demanded, the turning points that moved them forward, and the practical tips of the trade they use in their specific role. Guests come from every seat in the business, not just the corner office.

title: The Shadows Of Time
author: Jose Alejandre
description:
My books live at the crossroads of science fiction, legend, and introspection. You’ll find Ali Chalmer moving through scrapyard skies and FLAMSA cargo corridors, Peligroso 19 carrying memory like a scar, and Maquina—part human, part fox, part machine—learning tenderness inside a hard world.
I write with a love for wind, forests, tools, and silence: stories that feel cinematic and mythic, yet close to the ground—where coffee, steel, and starlight share the same table. Some titles read like adventures; others like meditations from deep space. Spanish & English editions depending on the book.

title: STEP ONE
author: Short Supply
description:
What’s the thing you keep saying you’ll do one day?
At Edinburgh Fringe, Short Supply founders Mollie and Bek Balshaw put out an orange chair and asked one question: What’s an idea you’ve always wanted to try, but haven’t yet?
People told us about unwritten books, unmade exhibitions, new skills, different lives and one musical based on the Bristol Stool Chart.
STEP ONE is an eight-part series about the ideas we carry, what stops us starting and how small a first step can be. Recorded live at the Scottish Storytelling Centre. Season One begins October. Follow now.

title: What The Mirror Misses
author: Arabella and Carla
description:
A space for women 40+. Real conversations. No filters. No gatekeeping.
Because the mirror never tells the whole story.

title: Fighting From Victory
author: Michelle Pinneo
description: Fighting From Victory is a Christian faith podcast with Michelle Pinneo about trusting God through cancer, fear, uncertainty, suffering, and life’s hardest seasons. Through biblical teaching, personal testimony, prayer, and practical encouragement, Michelle shares how to trust God when you’re afraid, pray when you don’t know what to say, guard your mind, find peace in difficult times, and stand on God’s promises. Michelle is walking through stage 4 colon cancer herself, so these messages aren’t coming from the other side of the battle. We aren’t fighting for victory. We’re fighting from it.

title: No One Will Hear This
author: Maria and Cathy
description: Conversations about freedom

title: Just Enough To Be Dangerous
author: Brie M
description: Come meet the people who had an unreasonable amount of confidence in a completely untested idea.  Have you ever heard the phrase:  “I know just enough to be dangerous.”  Usually it means someone knows just enough about something to get themselves into trouble. Turns out that’s also how a lot of businesses get started.  It’s how books get written.  Podcasts get launched.  Art gets created.  Degrees get finished.  Dreams get chased.  And entire lives get changed.  Most people don’t start because they feel completely ready.  They start because they know just enough to take the first step and have just enough gall to go for it.  That’s the idea behind Just Enough To Be Dangerous.  Grab a glass of wine and pull up a chair while we sit down with entrepreneurs, artists, creatives, writers, dreamers, self-starters, and everyday people who decided to stop waiting and see what would happen if they tried.  We’ll talk about:  🍷 The idea they couldn’t stop thinking about 😂 The mistakes they can laugh about now 🎨 The things they’ve built from scratch 🚀 The risks they took before they felt ready 💀 The moments they thought it would all fall apart ✨ The unexpected wins along the way  This isn’t a podcast about being the smartest person in the room.  It’s about having a wild idea, a stubborn streak, and enough belief in yourself to find out what’s possible.  If you’ve ever thought about starting a business, writing the book, creating the art, going back to school, changing directions, or simply seeing what you’re capable of...  I think you’re going to like it here.

title: Faithful Witness with Lucas Burton
author: Lucas Burton
description:
Faithful Witness exists to equip the church to realize its identity and purpose in view of Jesus’ promise: "you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you and will be my witnesses” (Acts 1:8).
Amid the complexities of a post-Christian culture, many believers are uncertain about how to share the gospel and many churches are asking how to equip their people for evangelism.
Join as we explore the intersection of theology, spiritual formation, and evangelism while equipping the whole church to communicate the whole gospel to the whole of life.

title: Law + Leadership
author: In Good Counsel
description:
Not a lot of lawyers would describe themselves as leaders, even though I think this features prominently in our work — especially my line of work in labour and employment.
I'm Peter Vlaar, an employment lawyer and the founder of In Good Counsel. I've perceived a gap in honest conversation between lawyers, HR professionals and business leaders around what it means to be a leader in the workplace. Law + Leadership is seeking to remedy that by creating conversations that encourage workplace leaders to lead better, in both our professional and personal lives.

title: TONE
author: Aaron Ridge
description:
Setting the standard. Setting the vibe. Setting the TONE.
Hosted by Aaron Ridge, TONE is a weekly deep dive into the minds of the city's most compelling creators and voices. We don't just scratch the surface; we explore the perspectives that shape our culture.
Produced by RadioFWD.
New episodes drop every Wednesday. Follow us on Instagram: @RadioFWD

title: Coach Curious
author: SayHello
description:
Coach Curious takes you behind the scenes with expert coaches to explore the ideas, strategies, and insights that drive real transformation. Each episode is a dynamic conversation with a certified coach, diving deep into their specialty and uncovering practical wisdom you can actually use. Expect fresh perspectives, surprising revelations, and the kind of engaging dialogue that makes you think differently about growth, change, and what's possible.
🔔 Stay Connected with SayHello:
Instagram: / joinsayhello  
LinkedIn:   / joinsayhello  
Facebook:   / joinsayhello  
TikTok:   / joinsayhello

title: Spirit Voices
author: Thundersley Christian Spiritualist Church
description:
Since 1933, Thundersley Christian Spiritualist Church has been exploring Spiritualism, working with Spirit and serving our community.

Spirit Voices brings together people from across the Spiritualist movement to share their experiences, ideas and perspectives. Through conversations with mediums, healers, speakers, church members and guests, we explore Spiritualism in all its forms - from the philosophy and teachings shared in our weekly Divine Services to mediumship, healing and experimental approaches to communication with Spirit.

Whether you are a practising Spiritualist, exploring your own spirituality or simply curious about life beyond the physical world, we invite you to listen, question and explore with us.

Welcome to Spirit Voices, from Thundersley Christian Spiritualist Church.

title: Parenting Hell with Rob Beckett and Josh Widdicombe
author: tfre
description: Parenting... just not as you know it.    Join Rob & Josh as they share their tales of parenting woe and chat to celebrity parents about how they're coping, or not coping.     Parenting Hell is a Spotify Podcast, video episodes available on Tuesdays and Fridays every week.

title: Where Should We Begin? with Esther Perel
author: frte
description: Every Monday morning step into the office of iconic psychotherapist Esther Perel on "Where Should We Begin" and listen in as real people in search of insight bare the raw, intimate, and profound details of their stories. From breakups and open relationships to workplace conflicts and fractures in the family, it’s a place to hear our own stories reflected in the lives of others. So…where should we begin? For an ad-free version of our podcast, plus bonus episodes, behind-the-scenes content, and more, visit our Office Hours section.

title: Significantly Weird
author: Christine Keelin
description:
Welcome to the stranger corner of organizational research.
Significantly Weird wanders through fascinating studies about leadership, communication, relationships, workplace psychology, and all the peculiar things humans do when we put them together in organizations. Expect curious findings, practical takeaways, occasional academic oddities, and as little jargon as reasonably possible.
Strange research. Real work. Limited jargon.

title: The G.O.C. Podcast
author: Yeshivat Mevaseret
description:
The GOC Podcast
GOC — Growth Oriented Chevra — is a weekly conversation about the things that matter: growth, Torah, life, and everything in between. Each week, Rav Burg sits down for an open and meaningful conversation, sharing ideas, stories, and perspectives that challenge us to think a little deeper and keep moving forward. At its heart, GOC is about the people of Mevaseret, the conversations that bring us together, and the belief that we’re all still growing.

title: Below Average Takes
author: ulloa.j24
description: Football, baseball, hot takes, and questionable opinions. Below Average Takes brings real sports conversations without pretending we're experts. Probably wrong. Definitely talking about it.

title: The Leaders With Lessons Podcast
author: Shaun Walsh
description:
Hosted by Shaun Walsh, co-founder of Perform Partners, the Leaders With Lessons podcast brings together senior leaders, founders, and decision-makers to explore the realities of leading change, transformation, AI adoption, and personal growth. Through honest conversations, guests share the lessons they've learned, the challenges they've faced, and the moments that shaped how they lead today.

These are not polished success stories or promotional interviews.
